name: Cubing at Iowa State 2025

venue.name: Radisson Hotel Ames Conference Center at ISU
venue.details: In the ballroom, follow the signs.

information:
This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcDAwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9d340df17a1aec4ba42677c10d4db2f31757ffba/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our cubing area. Feel free to join the [Iowa Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1629559883761917) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
